# Now 2.10.39
- Replaced visible queue-row scraping with YouTube Music's underlying player queue store. - Adjacent track previews now resolve even when Up Next rows have not been rendered onscreen. - Added reliable title, artist, artwork, selected-index, and video-thumbnail extraction from queue data. - Added queue-preview diagnostics and retained the DOM implementation as a compatibility fallback.

# Now 2.10.38
- Corrected YouTube Music queue parsing to use its current song-title and playback-state attributes. - Restored live next-cover previews before a forward swipe is committed. - Separated navigation history from artwork render timing so previously loaded covers remain available several songs deep. - Improved repeated backward and forward artwork transitions across longer listening history.

# Now 2.10.37
- Fixed forward-swipe previews by deduplicating YouTube Music queue rows and reliably resolving the next cover. - Added stronger current-row detection, thumbnail fallbacks, and short retries for queues that render late. - Reworked backward artwork history into a direction-aware stack. - Repeated backward swipes now move through earlier tracks instead of alternating between two covers.
